title: Password reset
request: Users should be able to reset their password if they forget it. Send them an email with a link. The link should expire.

title: Export report to CSV
request: Managers want to export the team's attendance report as a CSV so they can share it. They should be able to pick a date range.

title: In-app notifications
request: When something needs a user's attention — an approval, a mention — show them a notification in the app. They should be able to mark it as read.

title: Bulk upload (planted gap)
request: HR wants to upload new employees in bulk from a spreadsheet. Show them which rows succeeded and which failed.

planted_gap.description: What makes a row fail (validation rules) is implied but not stated.

title: Two-factor login (planted gap)
request: Add optional two-factor authentication at login using an authenticator app. Users can turn it on in settings.

planted_gap.description: Recovery when the device is lost (recovery codes, lockout) is not mentioned.

title: Comment on a document
request: Let users leave comments on a document and reply to each other. Comments should show who wrote them and when.
